label: eta_prime
source: PDG 2025 (pdglive, eta'(958) summary; S. Navas et al., Phys. Rev. D 110, 030001 (2024) and 2025 update)
rule: the eta'(958) at its PDG 2025 mass and width, its five leading modes (eta pi+ pi- 42.5%, rho0 gamma 29.5% for the pi+ pi- gamma mode, eta pi0 pi0 22.4%, omega gamma 2.52%, gamma gamma 2.31%) normalized over these; the eta's record as the template (I = 0, J^P = 0-); beside every continuum class with an eta the classes with the eta' in its place, each eta replaced and both in a class of two
